name: cad-reverse-engineer
description: Reverse-engineer CAD from papers: a parametric build123d model where every dimension traces to a quoted, hashed source and is checked against the built geometry.

interface.longDescription: Rebuild a part, gripper or mechanism from a paper, patent, supplement or datasheet as a parametric build123d model, STEP and MuJoCo, where every number the sources state is a verbatim quote and every stated value is checked against the built geometry. The cadrev CLI runs locally and needs uv; its first run downloads build123d, OCC and MuJoCo from PyPI, so under Codex's default sandbox allow network access for it.
defaultPrompt: Reverse-engineer the gripper in this paper as CAD
